convert_torchvision_to_d2: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model to Detectron2 .pkl format
run_model_weight_conversion: run the conversion script with input pth and output pkl file path arguments
convert_resnet_weights: convert torchvision ResNet18, 34, 50, 101, or 152 weights to Detectron2 compatible format
remap_torchvision_layer_keys: remap torchvision layer naming conventions to Detectron2 naming such as layer to res and bn to conv norm
dump_model_as_pickle: dump the converted model weights as a pickle file with matching heuristics metadata for Detectron2
